text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the hallway, I
encounter Mejiro Bright holding a
cleaning cloth and
looking full of
enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Time to scrub-a-dub the floor till
it's
squeaky clean.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Scrub-a-dub-dub...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swiiiish... Swiiiish...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Phew. It's hard to make much progress
using a wet
cloth. Perhaps I should
quicken my pace a little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swiiiish... Swiii—CRASH!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Sorry for worrying you. My foot
just
slipped, is all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's barely wiped anything down. At
this rate,
she'll be here all day before
she finishes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My! Hehe... Thank you so much for your
kind
offer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But I can finish this work on my own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I may be clumsy, but I can't simply give
up
whenever I hit the slightest bit of
resistance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Time to brush myself off and continue.
I'd like to
figure out what the trick to
doing this right is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Time to brush myself off and continue.
I'd like to
figure out what the trick to
doing this right is.
choice_data_list: Nothing to it but practice, right?
Just be careful not to get hurt.
Just be careful not to get hurt, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I feel even more motivated
thanks to
your words of encouragement.
choice_data_list: Nothing to it but practice, right?
Just be careful not to get hurt.
Just be careful not to get hurt, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Time to get back to work. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swiiiish... Swiiiish...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for worrying about me. You're
right. Getting injured would keep me
from being able
to run in my races, and
that wouldn't do at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'll be extra careful as I work. Here we
go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swiiiish... Swiiiish...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I walk by the same
hallway and
find it sparkling clean!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello. You're the same trainer from
before.
Watch your feet, please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Scrubbity dubbity...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unlike before, where she was cleaning
the floor inch by painful inch, Mejiro
Bright now flies down
the hall with her
cleaning cloth!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I asked to be put in charge of
wiping the floor every day. I've been
honing my skills little
by little by
polishing the floors in the dorm, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've finally gotten the hang of it, but I
still need
to devote more of myself to
this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Since I've come this far,
I figured I might
as well
aim to become a floor-wiping
specialist. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The polished hallway floor gleams in the
twilight
glow from the windows as Mejiro
Bright declares
her goal.
